children: The Thai telecommunications sector's slower service revenue growth outlook over 2027-2028 leads CGS International's Weerapat Wonk-urai to downgrade his call to underweight from overweight. The analyst expects companies in the sector to post revenue growth of 1.2%-1.9% over 2027-2028, compared with 4.6%-17% in 2025, citing a lack of new revenue drivers and monetization. The sector's valuation also seems pricey compared with peers in Southeast Asia, he adds. He cuts his 2027-2028 earnings-per-share estimates for Advanced Info Service by 4.1%-8.7% and trims his 2026-2028 EPS projections for True Corp. by 3.7%-8.6%. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
